en: Jātaka: The Second Book of Birth Stories (Dukanipāta), Chapter on the Firm (Daḷhavagga)
“Relying upon Alīnacitta, the great army was uplifted.”
He seized Kosala by the life-force while he was content with his army;
thus is one endowed with a support.
A bhikkhu who has aroused energy,
cultivating wholesome states for the attainment of security from bondage.
"One shall gradually attain the destruction of all fetters.
Thus ends the sixth Jātaka, the Alīnacittajātakam.
